# B"H
<!-- Boruch Hashem -->
<!-- Blessed is He -->

# Live Scheduler Timeout Repair

> The Awtsmoos reveals that essential light must dwell inside the tested scroll;
> Awtsmoos.com defers the distant garments, never the six mechanics that make play whole.

## Production Evidence

- Commit `186b995a8a00eaf0879b05cd5004b3d99343a065` deployed successfully.
- All nineteen model objects are public and immutable with exact recorded hashes.
- The live compact bundle matches the tested local SHA.
- The browser no longer reports model or optional-import 404s.
- The remaining fatal error is `Gameplay feature settlement timed out.` after twenty seconds.
- `createMinimalMeadowRuntime.js` still performs a runtime `import(FEATURE_SCHEDULER_URL)`.
- That source module graph can remain in module evaluation without an HTTP failure, leaving the outer feature promise pending forever.
- Essential bootstrap systems are therefore still outside the single tested compact execution graph.

## Root Ownership Decision

Essential bootstrap is not optional hydration. Inventory, equipment, combat, quests, recovery, streaming, controls, and their scheduler must be statically folded into the compact artifact. Player model hydration, renderer enhancement, friendly NPCs, and visual stability may remain dynamically deferred.

## Authorized Full-File Writes

1. Rewrite `src/app/createMinimalMeadowRuntime.js`:
   - remove `DeferredAppModuleUrl` and runtime scheduler import;
   - statically import `scheduleMinimalMeadowFeatures`;
   - preserve the bounded first-visible-opportunity gate;
   - call the scheduler directly after that gate.
2. Rewrite `tests/compactJs.mitzvahWorldRuntime.test.js`:
   - require the scheduler definition inside compiled output;
   - reject `FEATURE_SCHEDULER_URL` and its dynamic import;
   - preserve all Drive, readiness, and optional-import assertions.
3. Regenerate the entire compact artifact through `buildCompactRuntime.mjs`.
4. Run focused game tests, CompactJS suites, syntax, and real-entry compilation.
5. Commit only the authorized files, push, atomically deploy, and repeat a cache-bypassed browser trace.

## Completion Proof

The page must reach `awtsmoosRuntimeState=playable`, all six core systems must exist, and no fatal console exception or relevant HTTP failure may remain.
